versions.changelog:
Automotive Patent Valuation Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release offering a comprehensive evaluation model for high-value automotive patents.
- Implements a 14-factor scoring system across technical, legal, and economic dimensions, weighted at 40%/30%/30%.
- Integrates and maps to all 14 State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) high-value patent labels for full policy compliance.
- Provides patent screening, competitive benchmarking, compliance reviews, and strategic recommendations for automotive enterprises.
- Includes a 5-level grading system with explicit scoring thresholds and action strategies.
- Standardizes output formats for data review, scoring, benchmarking, and action matrix delivery.
